body.statement: For any subset \(S\subseteq I\) of cardinality \(t\) and any completed midrank vector, \(\sum_{i\in S}r_i(b)\ge t(t+1)/2\). Equality holds if and only if every label in \(S\) is strictly below every label outside \(S\). In particular, if \(t\) labels all have rank at most \((t+1)/2\), they form the unique lowest tied block and each has rank \((t+1)/2\).
body.justification: The equality characterization is the load-bearing converse that prevents tie faces from creating false graph certificates.
body.gap: Classical midrank identities give the total rank sum, but the subset equality condition is the exact combinatorial lemma required by this reduction.
body.consumer: A machine-checked version closes the remaining proof bottleneck in the NP-hardness argument.
